description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git multi-pack-index' functionality, including operations like writing, verifying, corrupting, and expiring multi-pack indices and associated pack files. It contains setup routines, test cases, and data manipulation functions, making it a test script rather than a standard source code file.

methods.name: midx_read_expect
methods.description: Checks the content of a multi-pack index by comparing the actual output with expected expectations based on the provided number of packs and objects.

methods.name: generate_objects
methods.description: Creates random objects in the repository for testing, simulating different delta structures.

methods.name: commit_and_list_objects
methods.description: Creates a commit, records the associated tree, and lists objects for indexing.

methods.name: corrupt_midx_and_verify
methods.description: Corrupts specific parts of the midx file at a given position and verifies that the system detects the corruption.

methods.name: corrupt_chunk
methods.description: Helper function to corrupt specific chunks in the midx file based on provided chunk identifiers and data.

methods.name: corrupt_data
methods.description: Corrupts arbitrary data at a specified position in a file, used to simulate corruption.
